gloss: dead branch; withered branch; dry twig

definitions.gloss: dead branch; withered branch; dry twig
definitions.explanation: A branch that has dried up and died on a tree, or one that has fallen from it. From {枯|か}れる (to wither) + {枝|えだ} (branch).

examples.japanese: {枯|か}れ{枝|えだ}が{風|かぜ}で{折|お}れた。
examples.english: A dead branch broke off in the wind.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}の{枯|か}れ{枝|えだ}を{切|き}って{束|たば}ねた。
examples.english: I cut the dead branches in the garden and bundled them.

notes:
Compound of {枯|か}れる (to wither, to die of a plant) + {枝|えだ} (branch).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {枯|か}れ{葉|は}: dead, fallen leaves
- {枯|か}れ{木|き}: a dead tree
- {小枝|こえだ}: a twig (not necessarily dead)
